title: Browser Wasm Ci
objective: Add public browser-Wasm parity, security, offline/cache, performance/payload, and reproducible release CI gates

handoff.summary: Adds a bounded heavyweight browser/native performance profile, v2 receipts with cold/warm timings, per-operation memory and evaluator route/copy telemetry, native ratio calculation, and release-workflow production of a same-workload native reference.
risks: Reviewed performance and browser/native ratio baselines intentionally remain null until final production artifacts produce empirical receipts.

The local lane had a stale native addon/generated-FFI pair, so the complete native receipt was not generated here; clean release CI rebuilds both together. Four non-number-field workload sources passed against the current root runtime, and the focused schema/gate tests passed.
next_steps: After capability instrumentation lands, run a production Chromium receipt and require every heavyweight workload's expected routes to be matched.
After the final reproducible artifact is selected, review receipts and populate performance_baseline, native_ratio_baseline, and a reviewed native ratio regression allowance.
